data.body:
**Import breaks the test rule**

The new `from unittest import mock` sits beside `import unittest`. The repository's test guide explicitly requires `import unittest.mock as mock` for this pattern because it triggers CodeQL alerts. Replace the new import with the required form before merging.

```suggestion
import unittest.mock as mock
```

**Context Used:** .claude/rules/tests.md ([source](https://github.com/thpoll83/polykybdhost/blob/main/.claude/rules/tests.md))

Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
